plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• TOSS SSC, Inter Result 2026 Out, Check Pass % : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SBI Clerk Backlog Prelims Marks 2026 Released : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SSC CPO Re : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SSC CPO Exam Cancelled 2026 for 26th Nov 1st Shift, Know the reason behind this : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

• CTET December 2026 city intimation slip released at ctet.nic.in; download link here : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

• Stage 1: Written Objective Examination (Child Pedagogy, Languages & Subject Concerned)
• Stage 2: Document Verification / Demo Teaching / Academic Merit List

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. Child Development & Pedagogy | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | Combined
• 2. Language-I & Language-II | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | 150 Minutes
• 3. Domain Subject (Maths/Science/Social/TGT/PGT) | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | (2.5 Hours)
• Total | 150 Qs | 150 Marks | 150 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Objective Multiple Choice Questions (OMR / CBT)
• Focus Area: NEP 2020, NCF, Inclusive Education, Pedagogy & Subject Mastery

• 3. Concerned Subject & GS: NCERT/SCERT Core Subject Syllabus (Class 6 to 12 Level), Indian National Movement, Polity, Geography & Environment, Basic Arithmetic, Reasoning & Current Affairs

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===

• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

• RSSB CET 12th Level Admit Card 2026 Out Today at recruitment.rajasthan.gov.in, Download Hall Ticket PDF : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Written Examination (OMR / Computer Based Test)
• Stage 2: Physical Standard Test (PST — Height/Chest) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET — Running)
• Stage 3: Document Verification & Detailed Medical Examination (DME)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Knowledge & Current Affairs | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | Combined
• 2. Numerical & Mental Ability | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | 120 Minutes
• 3. Mental Aptitude, IQ & Reasoning | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | (2 Hours)
• 4. General Hindi / English Language | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Written Exam) | 150 Qs | 300 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Objective Type Written Exam followed by Physical Endurance Test
• Negative Marking: 0.25 / 0.50 Marks deducted per wrong answer as per board rule
• Physical Requirement: Qualifying in PST & Running (PET) is mandatory

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. General Knowledge & State GK: Indian Constitution, Fundamental Rights & Police Act, History, Culture, Geography & Economy of India, State-Specific GK (Districts, Folk Arts, Rivers, Schemes), Internal Security, Human Rights & Cyber Crime, National & International Current Affairs & Awards
• 2. Reasoning & Mental Aptitude: Number/Letter Series, Coding-Decoding & Analogy, Direction Sense, Blood Relations & Ranking, Syllogism, Logical Venn Diagrams & Dice, Public Interest, Law & Order, Communal Harmony, Rule of Law, Professional Information & Police System
• 3. Numerical Ability (Maths): Number System, Simplification, HCF & LCM, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Partnership, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Mensuration
• 4. Language (Hindi / English): Varnmala, Sandhi, Samas & Upsarg-Pratyay, Tatsam-Tadbhav, Paryayvachi & Vilom Shabd, Muhavare, Lokoktiyan & Vakyansh ke liye ek shabd, Kaal, Vachya, Avyay & Ashuddhi Shodhan, Unseen Passage Comprehension & Famous Poets/Authors

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined

• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.

• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• PET / PST Date : 21 – 28 July 2026
• PET / PST Result : 29 October 2026
• Exam Mode : Online (CBT-Based)
• Paper 1 (Computer-Based Exam) Physical Standard Test (PST) / Physical Endurance Test (PET) Paper 2 (Computer-Based Exam) Medical Examination
• Physical Standard Test (PST) / Physical Endurance Test (PET)
• Medical Examination

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Question Type : (Multiple Choice Questions) Objective Type
• Exam Duration : 02 Hours

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

• Paper-I: General Studies (GS) & Current Affairs | 140–150 Qs | 200 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Paper-II: CSAT / General Hindi / Aptitude | 60–100 Qs | 100–200M | 120 Minutes

• 3. General Science & Current Affairs: Everyday Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Space & Biotech), National & International Current Events (Last 12 Months), Government Welfare Schemes & Census Data
• 4. Aptitude, Reasoning & Language: Comprehension & Interpersonal Communication Skills, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Decision Making, General Mental Ability & Class 10th Level Numeracy / Language

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===

• Balodabazar District Court Stenographer Admit Card 2026 (Post Group 2) : Gujarat Health Staff Nurse Waiting List 2026 Out - Check Place Selection Schedule PDF 30 minutes ago Arun Kumar (As per Notice)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Exam Stage Written Examination
• Written Exam Date 29 November 2026 (Sunday)
• Skill Test Admit Card To be issued separately
• The Stenographer Grade-3 written examination is scheduled for 29 November 2026 (Sunday). The reporting times printed on the admit card are listed below.
• Click the admit card link for the Stenographer Grade-3 (Hindi) or Stenographer Grade-3 (English) written examination.
• The written examination will be held on 29 November 2026 (Sunday) at Lakhi Prasad Tiwari Govt. Higher Secondary School, Balodabazar, as printed on the admit cards.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• SSC SR Technical Assistant Accepted and Rejected List 2026 Out - Download Tentative List PDF 7 minutes ago Priya
• Gujarat Health Staff Nurse Waiting List 2026 Out - Check Place Selection Schedule PDF 30 minutes ago Arun Kumar

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SSC CHSL Exam City Intimation Slip 2026 Out @ssc.gov.in, Check Direct Link : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• General Intelligence and Reasoning | 25 | 25
• General Knowledge and General Awareness | 25 | 25
• Quantitative Aptitude | 25 | 25
• English Comprehension | 25 | 25
• Total | 100 | 100
• Total Questions 100
• Exam Duration 60 Minutes
• Sectional Timer 15 Minutes per Section
• The four sections each have a 15-minute timer. Candidates should manage their time carefully because the examination follows sectional timing.

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.

Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SSC GD Physical Admit Card 2026 OUT, PET/PST Download Link : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• UIIC AO Mains Admit Card 2026, Download Phase 2 Call Letter @uiic.co.in : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• NTA UGC NET December 2026 Exam Dates OUT: Check City Slip Date, Admit Card Release and Other Details : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (General Studies + CSAT / Aptitude)
• Stage 2: Mains Written Examination (General Studies + Essay / Optional)
• Stage 3: Personality Test / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• Paper-I: General Studies (GS) & Current Affairs | 140–150 Qs | 200 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Paper-II: CSAT / General Hindi / Aptitude | 60–100 Qs | 100–200M | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Offline OMR / Online Objective Prelims followed by Mains
• Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) or 0.25 Marks per wrong answer as per Commission norms

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Indian Polity, History & Culture: Indian Constitution, Parliament, Judiciary & Panchayati Raj, Ancient, Medieval & Modern Indian History, Indian National Movement (1857–1947), Art, Culture & State-Specific Heritage
• 2. Geography, Environment & Economy: Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India & World, Ecology, Biodiversity, Climate Change & National Parks, Sustainable Development, Budget, Fiscal & Monetary Policy
• 3. General Science & Current Affairs: Everyday Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Space & Biotech), National & International Current Events (Last 12 Months), Government Welfare Schemes & Census Data
• 4. Aptitude, Reasoning & Language: Comprehension & Interpersonal Communication Skills, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Decision Making, General Mental Ability & Class 10th Level Numeracy / Language

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Odisha SSB Junior Assistant Admit Card 2026 Out (Today), Download Hall Ticket : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Written Examination (OMR / Computer Based Test)
• Stage 2: Physical Standard Test (PST — Height/Chest) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET — Running)
• Stage 3: Document Verification & Detailed Medical Examination (DME)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Knowledge & Current Affairs | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | Combined
• 2. Numerical & Mental Ability | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | 120 Minutes
• 3. Mental Aptitude, IQ & Reasoning | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | (2 Hours)
• 4. General Hindi / English Language | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Written Exam) | 150 Qs | 300 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Objective Type Written Exam followed by Physical Endurance Test
• Negative Marking: 0.25 / 0.50 Marks deducted per wrong answer as per board rule
• Physical Requirement: Qualifying in PST & Running (PET) is mandatory

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. General Knowledge & State GK: Indian Constitution, Fundamental Rights & Police Act, History, Culture, Geography & Economy of India, State-Specific GK (Districts, Folk Arts, Rivers, Schemes), Internal Security, Human Rights & Cyber Crime, National & International Current Affairs & Awards
• 2. Reasoning & Mental Aptitude: Number/Letter Series, Coding-Decoding & Analogy, Direction Sense, Blood Relations & Ranking, Syllogism, Logical Venn Diagrams & Dice, Public Interest, Law & Order, Communal Harmony, Rule of Law, Professional Information & Police System
• 3. Numerical Ability (Maths): Number System, Simplification, HCF & LCM, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Partnership, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Mensuration
• 4. Language (Hindi / English): Varnmala, Sandhi, Samas & Upsarg-Pratyay, Tatsam-Tadbhav, Paryayvachi & Vilom Shabd, Muhavare, Lokoktiyan & Vakyansh ke liye ek shabd, Kaal, Vachya, Avyay & Ashuddhi Shodhan, Unseen Passage Comprehension & Famous Poets/Authors

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• MP Police Admit Card 2026 Released for 655 Subedar and ASI Posts : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• RRB Paramedical Answer Key 2026: आआरबी पैरामेडिकल आंसर : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1 Screening)
• Stage 2: 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-2) / CBAT / Typing Skill Test
• Stage 3: Document Verification (DV) & Railway Medical Fitness Test (A2/B1/C2)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes

• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• Maharashtra HSC 12th Time Table 2027 Link Out @mahahsscboard.in : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SSC JE Answer Key 2026 Out, Objection Submission Begins: Commission Announces Mandatory Guidelines : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SSC JE 2026 answer key out at ssc.gov.in; submit objections by Nov 22 : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Junior Engineer : 1699 Posts
• Name of Department : Post Name (No. of Pots)
• Military Engineer Service (MES) : JE (Civil) (154)
• Military Engineer Service (MES) : JE (Electrical & Mechanical) (161)
• India Meteorological Department : Scientific Assistant (462)
• Border Road Organization (BRO) : Candidates who have passed their BE / B.Tech Degree in Related Trade OR Diploma in Related Trade with 2 Year Experience will be eligible for this recruitment.
• Brahmaputra Board, Ministry of Jal Shakti : Candidates who have Three-Year Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Institution will be eligible for this recruitment.
• Central Water Commission (CWC) : Candidates who have Engineering Degree / Diploma in Related Trade will be eligible for this recruitment.
• Central Public Works Department (CPWD) : Candidates who have doon with Engineering Diploma in Related Trade will be eligible for this recruitment.
• Central Water and Power Research Station : Candidates who have Diploma in Electrical Engineering from a recognized Institute will be eligible for this recruitment.
• DGQA-NAVAL, Ministry of Defence : Candidates who have Degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized Institute will be eligible for this recruitment.
• Farkka Barrage Project : Candidates who have Engineering Diploma in Related Trade will be eligible for this recruitment.
• Military Engineer Services (MES) : Candidates who have Degree in Related Trade OR Engineering Diploma in Related Trade with 2 Year Experience will be eligible for this recruitment.
• National Technical Research Organization (NTRO) : Candidates who have Engineering Diploma in Related Trade will be eligible for this recruitment.
• Director General of Lighthouses & Lightships, Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterway : Candidates who have Engineering Degree , Diploma in Related Trade will be eligible for this recruitment.
• Department of Telecommunication (DoT) : Candidates who have Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Technology in Electrical or Electronics or Electrical Communications or Computer Science or Telecommunications or Information Technology or Instrumentation from a recognized University or Institute. in Related Trade will be eligible for this recruitment.
• India Meteorological Department : Candidates who have Bachelor’s Degree in Science with Physics as one of the subjects from a recognized institution or university will be eligible for this recruitment.
• Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying : Candidates who have Degree or three-year diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Institute will be eligible for this recruitment.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• CBT (Tier-I Exam, Tier-II Exam) Document Verification Merit List
• CBT (Tier-I Exam, Tier-II Exam)
• Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

• Stage 1: 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1 Screening)
• Stage 2: 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-2) / CBAT / Typing Skill Test
• Stage 3: Document Verification (DV) & Railway Medical Fitness Test (A2/B1/C2)

• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

• SSC CHSL 2025 Tier : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification

• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs
